step_description: Fix example submodule compilation issues so the deterministic verifier’s COM-1 (all modules compile) gate passes.
prompt_text:
You are executing milestone M2 (Enforce in CI), focusing only on rubric item COM-1: "All modules compile (no mystery meat)".

Current verifier state (from hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json):
- COM-1 = FAIL
- Root module compilation appears OK; failures are coming from nested example modules under examples/* that have their own go.mod files.

Scope of this step (strict):
- You MAY modify files under examples/** that are required to make the example modules compile (e.g., example module go.sum/go.mod, and example-only Go files that do not compile).
- You MUST NOT modify production/library code under pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/** as part of this step.
- You MUST NOT change the rubric requirements or lower any gates.
- You MUST NOT modify the verifier logic except to re-run it for evidence (the goal is to fix the code so it passes, not to weaken checks).

Tasks (do in order):

1) Confirm the exact COM-1 failures
   - Read: hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log
   - Identify which example module directories fail (they will be printed as "Example module compile check: <dir>" followed by build errors).

2) Fix example module dependency checksum issues (go.sum)
   For each failing example module directory (for example: examples/event-adapters, examples/rate-limiting-limited, examples/websocket-demo):
   - From inside that module directory, run one of the following to populate missing go.sum entries:
     - Prefer: `go mod download` (minimal; should update go.sum as needed)
     - If download alone is insufficient: `go mod tidy` (may update go.mod/go.sum; acceptable only within the example module)
   - Do NOT run go mod tidy in the repo root for this step.

3) Fix any example compilation errors
   - If the COM-1 log shows an example Go compile error (e.g., unused imports), fix it with the smallest possible change.
   - Keep fixes strictly within the example module(s) that fail.
   - Example: if examples/event-adapters/cdk/main.go has an unused import, remove the unused import or use it intentionally (prefer removal unless usage is required).

4) Re-run the deterministic verifier to refresh evidence
   - Run: `bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh`
   - Confirm COM-1 is now PASS in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
   - Confirm hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log no longer contains failing example-module compile errors.
   - Do not attempt to fix other failing rubric items in this step (e.g., SEC-1, MAI-1, TODO/BLOCKED items).

5) Record progress under hgm-infra/
   - Create a short note file: hgm-infra/evidence/M2-COM-1-notes.md
     Include:
     - Date
     - Which example modules were changed
     - Commands run (e.g., go mod download / go mod tidy)
     - Any code fixes made (file paths + one-line description)
   - Update hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (append a short entry under a new "Progress log" section) noting COM-1 is now PASS and referencing the evidence log path.

Acceptance criteria
- `bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh` results in COM-1 = PASS.
- Changes are limited to example modules under examples/** (plus new/updated evidence under hgm-infra/**).
- No verifier/rubric dilution: no disabling checks, no changing thresholds, no widening excludes.

Deliverables
- Updated example module files needed for compilation (examples/** only).
- Refreshed: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json and hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log
- New: hgm-infra/evidence/M2-COM-1-notes.md
- Updated: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md
guardrails: Do not weaken or bypass any verifier checks (no exclusions/disablements/threshold changes).
Do not modify production/library code under pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/** in this step.
Only modify examples/** to resolve COM-1 compilation failures.
Do not run go mod tidy at the repo root in this step (example modules only).
Write all progress notes and evidence under hgm-infra/**.
